clinic.name: Kenneth J Bevan DDS
clinic.heroSubtitle: Transform your smile with a practice specializing in beautiful esthetic dentistry. From custom porcelain veneers to Invisalign, we deliver smile makeovers in a friendly, uplifting Napa environment.

differentiators.title: Esthetic Expertise
differentiators.description: Specializing in beautiful esthetic dentistry, Dr. Bevan focuses on creating confident, life-changing smiles.

differentiators.title: Century of Experience
differentiators.description: Our team brings over 100 years of combined dental experience to every procedure, from crowns to complex cases.

differentiators.title: Modern Dental Technology
differentiators.description: We utilize digital impressions and advanced scanners to ensure precision and comfort during your smile transformation.

differentiators.title: Uplifting Patient Culture
differentiators.description: Our practice is defined by a caring team and a stress-free environment that prioritizes your comfort.

treatmentJourney.title: Cosmetic Consultation
treatmentJourney.description: Meet with Dr. Bevan to discuss your aesthetic goals and undergo a comprehensive smile analysis using digital technology.

treatmentJourney.title: Digital Smile Preview
treatmentJourney.description: Visualize your future results with a digital design and select the perfect shade for your custom porcelain veneers.

treatmentJourney.title: Gentle Preparation
treatmentJourney.description: Your teeth are carefully prepared and digital impressions are taken to ensure a precise, comfortable fit for your restorations.

treatmentJourney.title: Custom Lab Fabrication
treatmentJourney.description: While your permanent veneers are crafted in a top-tier lab, we provide temporary veneers so you never leave without a smile.

treatmentJourney.title: Bonding and Reveal
treatmentJourney.description: Dr. Bevan expertly bonds your custom porcelain veneers, meticulously checking for a perfect fit and a natural aesthetic.

treatmentJourney.title: Long-Term Care Plan
treatmentJourney.description: We establish a follow-up and hygiene plan to protect your investment and ensure your new smile lasts for years to come.

benefits.title: Beautiful Esthetic Results
benefits.description: Dr. Bevan and his team love making beautiful teeth, ensuring you get the high-quality, radiant results you are looking for.

benefits.title: Uplifting Environment
benefits.description: Experience a positive vibe and a fun, welcoming atmosphere designed to make your time with us truly enjoyable.

benefits.title: Advanced Dental Tech
benefits.description: We invest in digital x-rays, scanners, and lasers to provide a more accurate diagnosis and a more comfortable experience.

benefits.title: Efficient Appointments
benefits.description: Your time is valuable, so our team works productively to ensure your visit runs smoothly without compromising on quality.

benefits.title: Personalized Care
benefits.description: Unlike corporate offices with revolving doors, we provide responsive care tailored specifically to your family's needs.

benefits.title: Comprehensive Services
benefits.description: From routine cleanings to complex smile makeovers and Invisalign, all your needs are met in one convenient Napa location.

implantOptions.title: Porcelain Veneers
implantOptions.description: Custom-crafted esthetic shells that transform the shape, color, and alignment of your teeth for a flawless smile.

implantOptions.title: No-Prep Veneers
implantOptions.description: Ultra-conservative veneers requiring minimal enamel removal.

implantOptions.title: Veneer Replacements
implantOptions.description: Replacing old, chipped, stained, or failing veneers.

faqItems.question: How long do porcelain veneers last?
faqItems.answer: With proper care and maintenance, high-quality porcelain veneers are a durable investment that can last 10-15 years or more.

faqItems.question: What is involved in a smile makeover?
faqItems.answer: A smile makeover at our Napa office combines esthetic treatments like veneers or crowns to address chips, gaps, and discoloration.

faqItems.question: Do you offer clear aligner options?
faqItems.answer: Yes, we are proud to offer Invisalign for patients looking to correct misaligned teeth with a nearly invisible solution.

faqItems.question: What should I expect at my first visit?
faqItems.answer: Your first visit includes a consultation and digital assessment to understand your goals and develop a tailored care plan.

faqItems.question: How do you ensure patient comfort?
faqItems.answer: We use an uplifting environment and gentle techniques to eliminate sensitivity and make dental visits stress-free.

faqItems.question: Where is your office located?
faqItems.answer: Our office is conveniently located at 3434 Villa Lane Ste 100 in Napa, where we serve the entire local community.

whyChoosePillars.title: Smile-Design First
whyChoosePillars.description: We design your full smile on screen before any tooth is touched, so you approve the look before we commit.

whyChoosePillars.title: Hand-Layered Porcelain
whyChoosePillars.description: Premium porcelain shaped and stained by an artisan lab — never a generic, monolithic look.

whyChoosePillars.title: Conservative Preparation

doctor.name: Kenneth J Bevan
doctor.bio: Kenneth J Bevan, DDS, provides premier cosmetic and general dental services to the Northern California community. Committed to delivering responsive, personalized care, Dr. Bevan and his team focus on creating a friendly and professional environment that respects each patient's time. With years of  experience, he specializes in esthetic work and smile makeovers, utilizing advanced technology like digital scanners and lasers to ensure beautiful, lasting results.

reviews.name: Gregory G.
reviews.text: Dr. Bevan accommodated an urgent appointment and took great care in fixing my problem. Not only is he a great dentist, he’s personable and outgoing.

reviews.name: Richard L.
reviews.text: The whole staff truly know what it means to provide a service. We have been customers of this office for 20 years and receive excellent care.

reviews.name: Alexandra A.
reviews.text: Dr. Bevan has always taken great care of me and did a wonderful job with my 8 year old son as well. We feel comfortable and well cared for.

reviews.name: Claire S.
reviews.text: I just love this office. It was easy, efficient, painless, and effective. If you need a dental family, go to this office, you will be very happy!

reviews.name: Roger U.
reviews.text: A comfortable, relaxed environment with a very knowledgeable, professional, efficient staff. They make it as stress-free as possible.

reviews.name: Felice H.
reviews.text: First office ever who was able to reduce and almost eliminate all my dental cleaning sensitivity. I am so looking forward to going back.
